callout_hierarchy.WARNING: Operating procedure or condition that, if not strictly followed, could result in personal injury, loss of life, or catastrophic crew hazard. Appears BEFORE the step.
callout_hierarchy.CAUTION: Operating procedure or condition that, if not strictly observed, could result in damage to equipment, loss of specimen, or loss of mission data. Appears BEFORE the step.
callout_hierarchy.NOTE: Essential operational context, tip, or physical explanation that aids execution without immediate hazard.

procedure_components: Pre-step WARNING / CAUTION / NOTE callout box
Sequenced numbered Action Step (Select -> Target -> Confirm)
values.verification_rule: Every physical valve, breaker, calibration, or containment step requires an explicit instrument or visual verification before the next step unlocks.
